Indication Type: Breakout of swing levels; shows entry/exit potential and the starting point of a trend
Swing Level Focus: Swing highs and swing lows (pivots) from the previous 1-3 trading sessions
No Trade Zone Conditions: Consolidation where price is trapped sideways between a high and a low with no clear direction
Correction Purpose: A calculated move to shake out FOMO traders and clean up the structure left by the initial explosive move
Liquidity Grab Mechanics: Liquidation of early breakout traders to tap into stop-loss pools and fuel the sustainable trend
Timeframe Correlation: 1H or 4H for identifying levels and indications; 15M or 5M for monitoring corrections and entries
